acceptance_contract: ACCEPT only if the lettering reads exactly "दीपावली की शुभकामनाएं", "सभी मिठाइयों पर 20% छूट" and "श्री गणेश मिष्ठान भंडार" — every character as given; REJECT on any wrong, missing, doubled or invented character.
REJECT if any other lettering or pseudo-lettering appears anywhere, or if any of the required lettering is cut by the frame edge or overlaps other lettering.

ACCEPT only if the lettering reads exactly "दीपावली की शुभकामनाएं", "सभी मिठाइयों पर 20% छूट" and "श्री गणेश मिष्ठान भंडार" — every matra and the conjunct ष्ठ in मिष्ठान correct, the figure 20 present as either 20 or २०; REJECT on any wrong, missing, doubled or invented character.
ACCEPT only if "श्री गणेश मिष्ठान भंडार" is the largest lettering on the poster.
REJECT if any other lettering or pseudo-lettering (scribbled or half-formed letters) appears anywhere.
ACCEPT only if at least one of a sweet box or lit diyas is recognisable.

case_values.CA-D1: 1st read: the offer line by contrast (bright gold on maroon); 2nd: the shop name by size (largest, cream, calmer contrast); 3rd: the greeting line. This resolves the stated contradiction: dominance by contrast (vig_0009), not by size.
case_values.CA-D2: Text block off-centre upper zone; props lower zone; the shop name spans the lower third.
case_values.CA-D3: Sparse frame: tight fit with a deliberate margin around every string (fre_0006); no string touches the edge.
case_values.CA-D4: None used (no border ornament that competes).
case_values.CA-D5: Balanced: the large pale name block below against the dense warm props and gold offer above.
case_values.CA-D6: 1:1 justified by the centred, inward-pointing arrangement of box and diyas (fre_0010).
case_values.PA-D1: sweet box: matte card (diffuse) with a glossy foil band (direct); diyas: matte clay with a small direct flame reflection on the oil; ground: matte deep maroon.
case_values.PA-D2: One highlight per diya flame on its oil surface, from the flame itself; no other speculars.
case_values.PA-D3: Soft ambient with small hard flame points only where flames are — declared, so the soft/hard mix is not a contradiction (each surface lit by its own declared source).
case_values.PA-D4: Fictional source: the diya flames, low and warm, lighting upward; key agrees.
case_values.PA-D5: Warm props against a cool-dark maroon ground; tonal contrast survives grayscale.
case_values.PA-D6: Low key, festive warmth from the character of flame light.
case_values.PA-D7: Sells at a glance: '20% off all sweets this Diwali at this shop' — the offer line is the first read.
case_values.PA-D8: Foil band on the box: one wanted specular; flame reflections wanted; nothing accidental.
case_values.PA-D9: Box at three-quarter showing lid top and front; diyas from slightly above.

generation_prompts.main: Diwali festive poster, square. On a deep maroon matte ground, lower area: an open box of Indian sweets (matte card box with one glossy gold foil band) beside three lit clay diyas whose flames light the scene from below with warm light; one small flame reflection on each diya's oil. Traditional motifs, clean modern layout with generous empty space. Text in Devanagari, all spellings exact: a top line reading "दीपावली की शुभकामनाएं"; below it, larger and in bright gold, the offer line "सभी मिठाइयों पर 20% छूट"; across the lower third, the largest lettering of all, in cream, the shop name "श्री गणेश मिष्ठान भंडार". No other words, letters or numerals anywhere.
generation_prompts.textless_plate: Diwali festive poster background, square. On a deep maroon matte ground, lower area: an open box of Indian sweets (matte card box with one glossy gold foil band) beside three lit clay diyas whose flames light the scene from below with warm light; one small flame reflection on each diya's oil. Traditional motifs, clean modern layout with the upper two-thirds and the lower third band left as empty maroon space. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no symbols anywhere in the image.
